retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast composition featuring a formal portrait against a saturated red field, distinguished by a white line-art illustration overlaid on a physical object.
triggerTerms: formal portrait with line art overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A man in a black tuxedo and white bowtie sits at a grand piano against a solid, vibrant red background. The piano is heavily stylized with a white, hand-drawn filigree or doodle-like line art overlay that obscures its natural surface. Bold, right-aligned serif typography occupies the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in formal black attire contrasting against a saturated red field
Physical piano serving as a canvas for white illustrative line art
Right-aligned text block balancing the left-weighted subject
High-key white accents in the bowtie and line art creating visual rhythm
coreInvariants: White line-art illustration overlaid on a dark object

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject seated on the left, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white line-art piano on the right side acts as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the piano, and then up to the bold text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open red space in the upper left and center provides breathing room for the subject and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast between black and white elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the soft yet bold 70s serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary weight and tight spacing characteristics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a black tuxedo and white bowtie sitting at a black grand piano against a solid, vibrant red studio background. The piano should be covered in intricate white line-art doodles and filigree patterns.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, right-aligned serif text in the upper right corner, using tight leading and tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Is the piano covered in white line art?
Is the text right-aligned and white?
Is the subject wearing a formal tuxedo?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High contrast between black, white, and red

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between red and black
Ensure line art does not look like a texture but like a drawing
Verify text alignment is strictly right-justified
Confirm the subject's attire is correctly rendered as a tuxedo
